string_values: Partial west-coast southward Leeuwin branch22–34S only. Excludes eastward Cape Leeuwin–Great Australian Bight continuation, South Australian/Zeehan currents, NW Shelf and northward undercurrent. Does not cover the full published Leeuwin naming scope or reproduce the earlier348degree mooring-frame operator.
Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.

Surface southward Philippine east-coast branch14.3N–5.5N. Excludes northward Mindanao Undercurrent, NECC/EUC/ITF continuations and Mindanao/Halmahera eddy circuits. The source near-surface climatological bifurcation is not a verified2022 axis or endpoint.

Pacific-side southwestward Oyashio regional46.2N–40N exploration; southern sections can intersect first/second intrusion branches and mixed eddies. Fixed225degree geographic component and cold-water gate do not independently distinguish branches, current vs eddy or actual southern extent. Exclude upstream East Kamchatka and eastward subarctic continuation.

temporal_scope: Two exact January/July15,2022snapshots,not seasonal means/annual extrema/source observations or climatology.
method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear strips on consecutive native longitude columns;minimum native-supported span where boundaries are censored. Original3km fixed-latitude geometry retained.
thermal_gate_interpretation: Oyashio native100m in-situ temperature<=5C is original horizontal selection only;connected depth nodes are velocity-threshold support,not3Dcold-water membership. This extends an editorial gate beyond source index geography,not a reproduction of JMA analyses or water-mass/current identity. Nonthermal owners and absent selected temperatures remain null.
surface_gate_interpretation: Original shared0.05m/s surface selection and graph surface connectivity remain distinct from primary layer contours and physical boundaries. Leeuwin primary0.05 versus Mindanao/Oyashio0.1 are not normalized.
minimum_span_interpretation: Conditional first-to-last contiguous native support under original piecewise-linear signed-component model,not physical current thickness bounds. Single-level zero is uninformative,not absence.
range_interpretation: Native-bracket sampling scenarios,not physical uncertainty,confidence intervals or annual envelopes.
identity_scope: Mindanao is partial surface southward branch,not opposing undercurrent/NECC/EUC/ITF or eddy circuits. Oyashio fixed southwest component/cold seed cannot independently distinguish intrusion branches/current/eddy or southern extent. Leeuwin partial west-coast southward reach is not full south-coast continuation/undercurrent or earlier348degree mooring-frame/monthlymean operator. No inherited depths or independently classified bodies.

interpretation: Partial regional component geometry,not independently identified named-current axis,flow-normal width,whole-route depth,terrain clearance or physical volume. No between-section physical interpolation or additive water bodies.
